message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a red left border. The word "TEMPO" is written in large, white, sans-serif letters across the top. Below, a man with light skin and dark hair lies horizontally across the roof of a large, multi-story building. He wears a dark suit, white shirt, and red tie, smiling while holding a lit cigar in his right hand and resting his head on his left hand.

The building is a symmetrical, neoclassical structure with several rows of windows and a central arched entrance. It appears to be made of light-colored stone or concrete. At the bottom, bold black text reads "MAINAN BARU TANOTO." Below this, smaller black text describes an investigation into Sukanto Tanoto and property in Germany.

The top of the cover includes the phrases "DRAMA KUDETA PARTAI DEMOKRAT" and "BABAK BARU KISRUH IMPOR GULA" separated by a diagonal line. A barcode, QR code, and date "8-14 FEBRUARI 2021" are in the bottom left corner. The background is a gradient of light blue and gray.
